title: Target Sum with (+ and *)

monster.name: Arithmetic Gorgon
monster.title: Weaver of Plus and Times Trees
monster.defeatQuote: Every + and * combination reaching target evaluated!

description: Given an array of positive integers `nums` and an integer `target`, insert either `'+'` or `'*'` between every adjacent pair of numbers (evaluating left-to-right). Return the count of assignments that equal `target`.
starterCode:
def targetSumOps(nums: list[int], target: int) -> int:
    pass
solutionCode:
def targetSumOps(nums: list[int], target: int) -> int:
    count = 0
    def dfs(idx, curr_val):
        nonlocal count
        if idx == len(nums):
            if curr_val == target: count += 1
            return
        dfs(idx + 1, curr_val + nums[idx])
        dfs(idx + 1, curr_val * nums[idx])
    dfs(1, nums[0])
    return count
